summary: Iteration 194 — FUUSIC Right-Rail Ad-Wallet + per-area DAILY SECOND-PRICE (Vickrey) auction + Category Targeting + Bid Alerts + Interest Onboarding. Backend pytest test_iter192_social_rail_v2_sponsor.py = 32/33 PASS (1 flaky test-order fail on TestRailEvents.test_records_impression_and_click — expected recorded==3 but got 2, caused by per-day anti-inflation dedup keyed on (user_id, card_id, action); the follow-impression event was already recorded by the demo session on an earlier suite run, so on rerun only the sponsored-impression and follow-click new-slot were persisted. NOT a product bug — RCA is idempotent dedup working correctly; the test needs unique card_ids per invocation, e.g. uuid.uuid4()). All other rail contract asserts pass: config (durations 1d/3d/7d, areas social/shop/listen, floor=$5, top-up presets), wallet owner-only (non-owner 403 not_your_business), eligible-shows owner-only, create validation (non-owner 403, not-your-show 404, bad_duration 400, no_target_areas 400, bid_below_floor 400), list shape (target_pages, daily_bid_cents, area_status per social/shop/listen with featured+rank+clearing_cents, featured_any, spend_cents, impressions, clicks, ctr, wallet_balance_cents, daily_floor_cents), second-price clearing (rsp_seed_hi $25 wins SOCIAL slot at clearing_cents between floor and own bid, wins LISTEN alone at floor $5), adjust bid re-settles and below-floor rejects, cancel 404 for unknown and ends the campaign, insights 7-day series+totals + non-owner 404, alerts owner-only + mark-read flips unread=0, interests GET topics>=8 + PUT filters invalid + skip flips needs_onboarding=false, rail events cap 50 + invalid actions filtered + bogus sponsorship still recorded but not attributed, sponsored injection first-card kind=sponsored badge SPONSORED, Marco Rossi surfaces with '4 mutual' hint, rail stays 5..7 cards. Web /merchant/rail-sponsor (test@) resolves Karak Cafe workspace, renders [data-testid=merchant-rail-sponsor] with Ad-Wallet panel ($474.99 balance, real 2nd-price clearing txn ledger: 'Charge Rail:Shop -$X.XX' and 'Refund Resettle:Shop +$X.XX' entries interleaved), Add-funds top-up modal (rail-topup-modal + rail-topup-preset-{2000,5000,10000,25000} + rail-topup-submit), Alerts bell → rail-alerts-modal listing individual outbid alerts (rail-alert-<id>), campaign cards with area-status chips (rail-sponsor-area-status-<sid>-<area>), Featured badge on rsp_seed_hi + rsp_seed_lo, Raise-bid modal (rail-sponsor-raise-modal + rail-sponsor-raise-input + rail-sponsor-raise-submit), Cancel button (rail-sponsor-cancel-<sid>), Insights toggle expands trend section, 'Your shows to feature' shows lsw_sponsor_evt + lsw_sponsor_live with Feature-this buttons. Web Interest Onboarding on New Look V2 shell (/social?design=new_look_v2) auto-opens for demo (needs_onboarding=true) — [data-testid=interest-onboarding] + 10 onboarding-interest-<TOPIC> chips (TAROT/DREAMS/ASTROLOGY/HOROSCOPE/NUMEROLOGY/MEDITATION/WELLNESS/LIVE_MUSIC/DJ_SETS/PODCASTS) + onboarding-save (PUT /api/social/interests) + onboarding-skip (POST /api/social/interests/skip); save with 2 selected persists and closes modal. Mobile Expo Social tab (after demo-login-btn → POST /api/auth/demo) shows same InterestOnboarding modal as a bottom sheet with same testIDs; save closes; parity matches web.

Add stable testIDs to /merchant/rail-sponsor Feature-a-show modal (rail-sponsor-tier-modal, rail-sponsor-bid-input, rail-sponsor-area-chip-<area>, rail-sponsor-submit) for deterministic E2E.

critical_code_review_comments: Second-price auction is correctly enforced at read-time in /api/social/rail/sponsor/list (per-area rank + clearing_cents derived from active bids), NOT by mutating losers. Clean and idempotent. Single-bidder clears at floor=$5 as expected.

Wallet ledger contains matching Charge/Refund pairs after re-settle when a new bid arrives — good, this proves the daily clearing model actually re-runs and refunds the delta rather than double-charging.
Cancel is still a single tap on a paid campaign (no confirm dialog). Mild UX risk carried from iter192/193 — consider a simple confirm().

Merchant rail-sponsor page: 767 lines in one JSX file (MerchantRailSponsor.jsx). Approaching the 700-line soft cap — consider splitting AdWalletPanel, FeatureModal, RaiseModal, AlertsInbox, CampaignRow into separate components.
InterestOnboarding modal on mobile is a bottom Modal with animationType='fade' and no keyboard avoidance; not an issue for a 10-chip picker but flag if the copy grows.
Rail-event dedup is per user_id + card_id + action per day. Works well for anti-inflation on real cards but makes test replays brittle unless card_id is unique — see action item.
Alerts inbox correctly shows 'Outbid on the rail' entries with per-area context ('Shop rail slot') and CTA to raise. Good product surface.

rca of the issue: Only unresolved test failure: TestRailEvents.test_records_impression_and_click. RCA: /api/social/rail/event applies anti-inflation dedup by (user_id, card_id, action) inside a UTC day. The test sends 3 events with card_id='test-card-a' + 'sponsored-x'; on a fresh session all 3 persist; on a rerun of the same suite in the same UTC day, the follow-impression (card_id='test-card-a', action='impression') is already in db.rail_events so only 2 new rows persist and the endpoint returns recorded=2. This is CORRECT PRODUCT BEHAVIOR (prevents click farms), the test is stale. MITIGATION: change the test to use uuid4() card_ids OR delete rail_events for the demo user in a teardown fixture.
